Agent Name: GameTheory_Expert
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: They mis-modeled and enumerated the feasible box counts: after setting c = b + 6, they listed triples that don’t even sum to 30 (e.g., (12, 6, 18)), and ignored ordering constraints. They then incorrectly concluded that guessing (2, 11, 17) guarantees winning all 30 coins, overlooking that guesses are assigned to boxes before reveal and an adversarial placement/permutation can make some guesses exceed box counts. These errors led to the wrong $30,000 result instead of the correct $16,000.
